question: What language(s) is/are represented in the dataset?

evidence: As described before one crucial issue that we are trying to tackle in this work is that the given dataset is imbalanced. Particularly, there are only a few instances from indirect and physical harassment categories respectively in the train set, while there are much more in the validation and test sets for these categories. To tackle this issue we applying a back-translation method BIBREF13, where we translate indirect and physical harassment tweets of the train set from english to german, french and greek. After that, we translate them back to english in order to achieve data augmentation. These "noisy" data that have been translated back, increase the number of indirect and physical harassment tweets and boost significantly the performance of our models.

title: Attention-based method for categorizing different types of online harassment language
answer_rationale: Text 5 explicitly states that the dataset includes tweets translated from English to German, French, and Greek, and then back to English for data augmentation. This implies the original dataset is in English, as the back-translation is applied to English tweets to increase data size. No other languages are mentioned as part of the original dataset.
